recent_espn_transactions.description: Claimed LB Tyrus Wheat off waivers from Dallas. Waived DB Nick Whiteside.
Released DT David Blay Jr. from the practice squad.
Signed WR Jason Brownlee and DB Bishop Fitzgerald to the practice squad.
Signed CB Johnathan Edwards from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed TE Harrison Bryant and WR Samori Toure to the practice squad.
Signed QB Brett Rypien to the practice squad. Released DE Bralen Trice from the practice squad.
Placed C Dylan McMahon on injured reserve. Waived WR Brennan Presley. Released DT Jalen Hunt from the practice squad.
Waived K Zane Gonzalez and LB Jamree Kromah.
Placed WR Jordan Addison on injured reserve.
Signed WR Xavier Gipson from Philadelphia's practice squad and DB Tavierre Thomas from Minnesota's practice squad to the active roster. Waived WR Charlie Jones and DB Nikko Reed.

Signed TE Zach Ertz and OT John Ojukwu from the practice squad to the active roster. Designated RB Will Shipley to return from injured reserve. Signed RB Jaydon Blue, LB Chance Campbell and TE Hayden Rucci to the practice squad. Released DB Shaun Wade from the practice squad.
Reinstated TE David Njoku and LB Denzel Perryman from injured reserve. Elevated DE Myles Adams from the practice squad. Placed G Branson Taylor on injured reserve.
Waived NT Deven Eastern.

Signed QB Easton Stick from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed QB Cooper Rush and WR David Sills V to the practice squad. Released WR David Sills V. Released CB Brandon Johnson from the practice squad.
Signed DB Marco Wilson from the practice squad to the active roster. Waived LB Nick Hampton.
Signed OT Chuma Edoga from the practice squad to the active roster. Elevated WR Chris Moore and TE Nick Vannett from the practice squad.
Elevated LB J.J. Quinn and DB Jammie Robinson from the practice squad.
Activated DB Jordan Hancock from injured reserve. Released DB Te'Cory Couch. Elevated QB Shane Buechele from the practice squad.
Signed TE Carsen Ryan to the active roster. Placed FB Michael Burton on injured reserve. Elevated TE Zaire Mitchell-Paden from the practice squad.

Placed RB Tyler Goodson on injured reserve. Waived LB Tyrus Wheat. Signed TE James Mitchell to the active roster. Activated DT Jonathan Bullard from injured reserve. Elevated RB Israel Abanikanda and CB Derion Kendrick from the practice squad.
Elevated LB Owen Pappoe from the practice squad.
Activated RB Chris Brooks and WR Skyy Moore from injured reserve. Placed TE Josh Whyle on injured reserve. Elevated TE Drake Dabney from the practice squad. Waived WR Coleman Owen.

Placed G Peter Skoronski and P Tommy Townsend on injured reserve. Signed G Chandler Zavala, DB Isaiah Oliver and P Thomas Morstead to the active roster. Waived RB Michael Carter. Elevated WR Xavier Restrepo and LB Dominique Hampton from the practice squad.

Placed LB Akeem Davis-Gaither and TE Mo Alie-Coxon on injured reserve. Activated DE Arden Key from injured reserve. Signed LB West Weeks to the active roster. Elevated S Jacob Bobenmoyer and WR Quez Watkins from the practice squad.
Elevated RB Nate Carter and WR Jacob De Jesus from the practice squad.
Elevated TE Carter Runyon from the practice squad.
